## Appearance

Di is a very pretty girl who possesses black eyes, black hair, and rosy cheeks. She inherits her merry expression from her father and is described as being both rosy and dimpled.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. ## Personality

Di is characterized by her good nature and intelligence. These traits are considered to define her worth far more than her physical appearance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040)_

## History

Di, also known as Diana Barry, became [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's sworn best friend after they met in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). She later hosted a party at her house where [Anne](../character/anne.md) fell off the roof and broke her ankle, prompting a lengthy recovery. Though [Diana](../character/diana.md) did not join the advanced Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) class alongside [Anne](../character/anne.md), she continued to share adventures with her, including collecting donations for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) and helping [Anne](../character/anne.md) recover from a facial dye mishap to successfully host famous guest Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P1](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P2](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P3](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P4](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P7](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), +167 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--di.md)

Di shares a close, enduring bond with [Anne](../character/anne.md). They have been dedicated schoolmates and close friends since their childhood.

- Friend of — close friends and schoolmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P3](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0003), +6 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--di.md)

Di and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) became instant, lifelong friends after meeting in the orchard at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), solemnly swearing a vow to be best friends forever. They spend their youth sharing parties, gathering subscriptions for the local improvement society, and helping one another out of mishaps, such as when Di helped [Anne](../character/anne.md) entertain a famous author after a dye accident. Though a temporary rift in their shared routines occurs when [Anne](../character/anne.md) enters advanced studies and eventually leaves for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), they remain deeply affectionate chums.

- Friend of — close friends and chums  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P0](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0000), +4 more</sub>

### [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/di--fred-wright.md)

Di engaged in a courtship with [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) that eventually culminated in their marriage. After tied in a wedding ceremony, the two drove away together to start their life in a new home.

- Romantically involved with — courting (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P12](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0012), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)</sub>
- Spouse of — married in a ceremony and drove away together to their new home (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Wedding P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013)</sub>
